item.title: Soongsil University's G-LAMP Project Team Supports Local High School Students' Exploration of STEM Career Paths (숭실대 G-LAMP사업단, 지역 고교생 이공계 진로 탐색 지원)
item.description:
Soongsil University's G-LAMP Project Team (led by Director Kang Wi-kyoung) announced that it has undertaken efforts to nurture future talent in connection with the local community by operating eight high school special lectures and two natural science experiment and major exploration programs to support local high school students in exploring STEM career paths and strengthening their capabilities in science and technology. (숭실대학교 G-LAMP사업단(단장 강위경)은 지역 고등학생들의 이공계 진로 탐색과 과학기술 역량 강화를 위해 고교 특강 8회와 자연과학 실험·전공체험 프로그램 2회를 운영하며 지역사회와 연계한 미래 인재 양성에 나섰다고 밝혔다.)

These programs were designed to give high school students the opportunity to experience the university's educational and research environment and enhance their understanding of cutting-edge science and technology fields such as natural sciences and artificial intelligence (AI). Soongsil University faculty introduced the latest research成果 and academic majors, and provided customized education to support students' career exploration. (이번 프로그램은 고등학생들이 대학의 교육·연구 환경을 경험하고 자연과학과 인공지능(AI) 등 첨단 과학기술 분야에 대한 이해를 높일 수 있도록 마련됐다. 숭실대 교수진이 최신 연구 성과와 전공을 소개하고 학생들의 진로 탐색을 위한 맞춤형 교육을 진행했다.)

The high school special lectures were held in connection with Soongsil University's Office of Admissions at eight schools, including Nowon High School, Dongduk Girls' High School, Dongmyeong Girls' High School, Gajaewool High School, Yeongdeungpo High School, Gyeongmun High School, Chungang University Affiliated High School, and Simsuk High School. Topics included AI and drug development, AI and life sciences, quantum information science, AI and bio-inspired computing, and medical informatics and AI, introducing the latest research trends as well as the vision and career opportunities in the natural sciences. (고교 특강은 숭실대 입학처와 연계해 노원고, 동덕여고, 동명여고, 가재울고, 영등포고, 경문고, 중앙대부고, 심석고 등 8개교에서 열렸다. AI와 신약개발, AI와 생명과학, 양자정보과학, 인공지능과 생체모사 컴퓨팅, 의료정보와 인공지능 등을 주제로 최신 연구 동향과 자연과학 분야의 비전과 진로를 소개했다.)

In addition, natural science experiment and major exploration programs were held for students from Wonju Daeseong High School and Chuncheon Yubong Girls' High School. Participating students experienced university-level experiments and research equipment in the fields of chemistry, physics, and life sciences, gaining an understanding of the convergence of natural sciences with AI, biotechnology, and medical fields. (또 원주 대성고와 춘천 유봉여고 학생들을 대상으로 자연과학 실험·전공체험 프로그램을 운영했다. 참가 학생들은 화학·물리학·생명과학 분야의 대학 수준 실험과 연구 장비를 체험하며 자연과학과 AI, 바이오, 의료 분야의 융합 과정을 이해하는 시간을 가졌다.)

The Soongsil University G-LAMP Project Team plans to continue expanding cooperation with local high schools to provide high-quality science education and career exploration opportunities, and to strengthen its role as a platform for nurturing science and technology talent that grows together with the local community. (숭실대 G-LAMP사업단은 앞으로도 지역 고교와의 협력을 확대해 수준 높은 과학 교육과 진로 탐색 기회를 제공하고, 지역사회와 함께 성장하는 과학기술 인재 양성 플랫폼으로서의 역할을 강화해 나갈 계획이다.)

A representative of the Soongsil University G-LAMP Project Team stated, "We hope this served as an opportunity for students to experience the appeal of the natural sciences and the value of research through meetings with university faculty and major-related experiments," adding, "We will continue to work closely with the local community to steadily expand educational programs aimed at nurturing creative talent who will lead the future of science and technology." (숭실대 G-LAMP사업단 관계자는 "학생들이 대학 교수진과의 만남과 전공 실험을 통해 자연과학의 매력과 연구의 가치를 경험하는 계기가 되었기를 바란다"며 "앞으로도 지역사회와 긴밀히 협력해 미래 과학기술을 선도할 창의적 인재 양성을 위한 교육 프로그램을 지속적으로 확대해 나가겠다"고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Sahmyook University Holds Completion Ceremony for Senior Model Advanced Course 4th Cohort... 11 Graduates Produced (삼육대, 시니어모델 최고과정 4기 수료식… 11명 배출)
item.description:
Sahmyook University (President Je Hae-jong) successfully wrapped up the Basic 4th cohort of its 'SU-MVP Senior Model Advanced Course,' producing a total of 11 senior models. (삼육대(총장 제해종)는 ‘SU-MVP 시니어모델 최고과정’ 베이직 4기를 성황리에 마무리하며 총 11명의 시니어모델을 배출했다.)

The completion ceremony was held on July 28 at the Jang Geun-cheong Hall in the International Education Building on campus. About 50 people attended the event, including President Je Hae-jong, Graduate School Dean Son Ae-ri, General Alumni Association President Oh Deok-sin, Senior Model Alumni Association President Choi Cheong-su, along with graduates, their families, and alumni from the 1st to 3rd cohorts. (수료식은 지난 7월 28일 교내 국제교육관 장근청홀에서 열렸다. 이날 행사에는 제해종 총장, 손애리 대학원장, 오덕신 총동문회장, 최청수 시니어모델 총원우회장과 수료생, 가족, 1~3기 원우 등 50여 명이 참석했다.)

Sahmyook University's Senior Model Advanced Course is a non-degree educational program that supports new challenges for middle-aged and older adults, aligned with 'Well-aging' and 'New Senior' trends. It aims to systematically cultivate the professionalism required of senior models. (삼육대 시니어모델 최고과정은 ‘웰에이징(Well-aging)’, ‘뉴 시니어’ 트렌드에 맞춰 중장년층의 새로운 도전을 지원하는 비학위 교육 프로그램이다. 시니어모델에게 필요한 전문성을 체계적으로 함양하는 것을 목표로 한다.)

The Basic 4th cohort program ran over 14 weeks and included essential training such as △fashion show trend analysis △walking and posing △performance △nutrition and health management △fashion styling △image making △speech. At the end of the course, all graduates demonstrated their practical skills through a fashion show presentation, marking a new beginning as senior models. (이번 베이직 4기 과정은 14주에 걸쳐 △패션쇼 트렌드 분석 △워킹 및 포즈 △퍼포먼스 △영양·건강관리 △패션 스타일링 △이미지 메이킹 △스피치 등 필수 역량 교육으로 진행됐다. 과정 말미 패션쇼 발표회로 실전 감각까지 익힌 수료생 전원은 시니어모델로서의 새로운 출발을 알렸다.)

In his congratulatory address, President Je Hae-jong said, "As the saying goes, 'There's no age limit to challenge,' I congratulate you on your achievements beyond limits," and added, "I hope you will shine confidently not only on the runway but also on the stage of life." (제해종 총장은 축사를 통해 “‘도전에는 나이가 없다’는 말처럼 한계를 넘어선 여러분의 성취를 축하한다”며 “런웨이를 넘어 인생의 무대에서도 당당하게 활약하길 기대한다”고 말했다.)

An advanced course is scheduled to begin in September. It is a leadership training program for Basic course graduates, covering in-depth study over 14 weeks of professional walking instruction methods, lecture planning and management, and teaching methodologies for seniors. Upon completion, participants can obtain a Walking Education Specialist Instructor certificate and work as instructors at local government cultural centers and sports centers in the future. (오는 9월에는 어드밴스드 과정이 개강할 예정이다. 베이직 수료생을 대상으로 한 지도자 교육 과정으로, 14주간 전문 워킹 지도법, 강의 기획·운영, 시니어 대상 교육 방법론 등을 심화 학습한다. 과정 이수 시 워킹교육전문지도사 자격증을 취득할 수 있으며, 향후 지자체 문화센터 및 체육센터 등에서 강사로 활동할 수 있다.)

For course inquiries, contact the Sahmyook University Senior Model Advanced Course office (☏ 010-2008-3625, AMP@syu.ac.kr). (수강 문의는 삼육대 시니어모델 최고과정 사무국(☏ 010-2008-3625, AMP@syu.ac.kr)으로 하면 된다.)

item.title: University of Seoul and Royal University of Phnom Penh Produce Cambodia's First 31 Graduates in Urban Planning (서울시립대-프놈펜왕립대학교, 캄보디아 최초 ‘도시계획 학사’ 31명 배출)
item.description:
The University of Seoul (President Won Yong-gol) announced that on the morning of July 31, it held the first graduation ceremony at the Royal University of Phnom Penh (RUPP), Cambodia's top national university, producing 31 graduates in urban planning—the first-ever undergraduate cohort in this major in Cambodian history. (서울시립대학교(총장 원용걸)는 7월 31일 오전, 캄보디아 최고 국립대학인 프놈펜왕립대학교(Royal University of Phnom Penh, RUPP)에서 캄보디아 역사상 최초의 도시계획 전공 학부 졸업생 31명을 배출하는 제1기 졸업식을 개최했다고 밝혔다.)

The ceremony marks a landmark achievement of the "Leading University for International Cooperation Development and Support Project," which the University of Seoul's Graduate School of Urban Sciences (Dean Lee Shin, Project Director Park Hyun) has been carrying out since 2021 with support from the Ministry of Education and the National Research Foundation of Korea. After the two universities obtained approval in May 2022 to establish the Department of Sustainable Urban Planning and Development (DSUPD)—Cambodia's first independent urban planning department—they have successfully integrated the University of Seoul's distinguished urban planning curriculum and Korea's urban development expertise into the local program. (이날 졸업식은 서울시립대 국제도시과학전문대학원(원장 이신, 사업단장 박현)이 2021년부터 교육부와 한국연구재단의 지원을 받아 추진하고 있는 ‘국제협력 선도대학 육성·지원사업’의 대표적인 성과다. 양교는 2022년 5월 캄보디아 최초의 독립된 도시계획학과인 ‘지속가능도시계획및개발학과(Department of Sustainable Urban Planning and Development, 이하 DSUPD)’ 설립 인가를 획득한 이후, 서울시립대학교의 우수한 도시계획 커리큘럼과 한국의 도시개발 노하우를 현지 교육과정에 성공적으로 접목해 왔다.)

The graduation ceremony was attended by around 200 key figures from both countries' governments and academia, including University of Seoul President Won Yong-gol and RUPP President CHET Chealy, as well as Kim Chang-yong, South Korean Ambassador to Cambodia; PEN Sophal, Secretary of State at the Ministry of Land Management, Urban Planning and Construction; SOM Ratana, Under Secretary of State at the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport; Benghong Socheat Khemro, Director General of the General Department of Land Management and Urban Planning at the Ministry of Land Management, Urban Planning and Construction; and SENG Vannak, Deputy Governor of Phnom Penh. They gathered to celebrate the emergence of the first experts who will lead the future of Cambodia's cities. (졸업식에는 원용걸 서울시립대학교 총장과 쳇 첼리(CHET Chealy) 프놈펜왕립대학교 총장을 비롯하여 김창용 주캄보디아 대한민국 대사, 펜 소팔(PEN Sophal) 국토관리도시계획건설부 차관, 솜 라타나(SOM Ratana) 교육청소년체육부 차관보,  벵홍 소쳇 켐로(Benghong Socheat Khemro) 국토관리도시계획건설부 국토관리도시계획국장, 생 반낙(SENG Vannak) 프놈펜시 부시장 등 양국 정부와 학계의 주요 인사 200여 명이 참석해 캄보디아 도시의 미래를 이끌어갈 첫 전문가들의 탄생을 축하했다.)

In his congratulatory address, University of Seoul President Won Yong-gol said, "We launched this project in 2021 with the belief that knowledge and experience grow and transform the world when shared." He added, "The 31 graduates today are world-class professionals combining Seoul's development experience with the academic foundation of the Royal University of Phnom Penh, and they will become pioneers writing a new chapter in Cambodia's urban history." (원용걸 서울시립대 총장은 기념사를 통해 “지식과 경험은 공유될 때 성장하고 세상을 변화시킨다는 신념으로 2021년 이 사업을 시작했다”며, “오늘 졸업한 31명의 인재는 서울의 개발 경험과 프놈펜왕립대학교의 학문적 토대가 결합된 세계적 수준의 전문가로서 캄보디아 도시 역사를 새롭게 써 내려갈 개척자가 될 것”이라고 격려했다.)

Over the past six years, the University of Seoul has worked to build the educational foundation for DSUPD, co-developing 28 major curricula and textbooks, providing faculty capacity-building training, establishing infrastructure such as smart classrooms, supplying educational equipment, operating domestic internship programs, and building industry-academia cooperation networks. In particular, the graduates completed practical internships during their studies at Cambodia's Ministry of Land Management, Urban Planning and Construction and the Phnom Penh City Hall, equipping them with field-response capabilities. They are now set to work as urban experts spanning both the public and private sectors. (서울시립대학교는 지난 6년간 DSUPD 운영을 위해 28개 전공 커리큘럼과 교재를 공동 개발하고, 교수진 역량 강화 연수, 스마트 강의실 등 인프라 구축, 교육 기자재 지원, 국내 인턴십 프로그램 운영, 산학협력 네트워크 구축 등 교육 기반 조성에 힘써왔다. 특히, 졸업생들은 재학 기간 중 캄보디아 국토관리도시계획건설부와 프놈펜 시청 등에서 실무 인턴십을 수행하며 현장 대응 능력을 갖추었으며, 앞으로 공공과 민간 분야를 아우르는 도시 전문가로 활동할 예정이다.)

During this visit, University of Seoul President Won Yong-gol and his delegation held high-level meetings with the RUPP President and officials from the Phnom Penh City Hall, and agreed to pursue the establishment of a "Smart City and Infrastructure Development Research Center (tentative name)" at RUPP to ensure sustainable cooperation even after the project concludes. Based on this, the two institutions plan to further strengthen joint research and knowledge exchange in the field of urban planning. (서울시립대학교 원용걸 총장과 방문단은 이번 방문 기간 중 프놈펜왕립대학교 총장 및 프놈펜 시청 관계자들과 고위급 면담을 갖고, 사업 종료 이후에도 지속 가능한 협력을 위해 프놈펜왕립대학교 내에 ‘스마트 도시 및 인프라 개발 연구센터(가칭)’ 설립을 추진하기로 했다. 양 기관은 이를 기반으로 도시계획 분야의 공동 연구와 지식 교류를 더욱 공고히 할 계획이다.)

Meanwhile, the University of Seoul contributes to urban development both domestically and internationally, drawing on its accumulated educational and research capabilities and policy development experience across the entire urban field, including urban engineering, urban planning, transportation engineering, and urban administration. The Graduate School of Urban Sciences, which oversaw this project, is a specialized graduate school established to share Seoul's urban development experience and policy know-how with the international community. Since its founding in 2013, it has actively operated master's and doctoral degree programs, international training, and Official Development Assistance (ODA) projects for public officials and urban experts from developing countries. Since transitioning to a specialized graduate school in 2025, it has further intensified its efforts to nurture professionals who will lead the resolution of global urban challenges and sustainable urban development. (한편, 서울시립대학교는 도시공학, 도시계획, 교통공학, 도시행정 등 도시 분야 전반에 걸쳐 축적된 교육·연구 역량과 정책 개발 경험을 바탕으로 국내외 도시 발전에 기여하고 있다. 이번 사업을 주관한 국제도시과학전문대학원은 서울의 도시발전 경험과 정책 노하우를 국제사회와 공유하기 위해 설립된 도시 분야 특성화 전문대학원이다. 2013년 개원 이후 개발도상국 공무원과 도시 전문가를 대상으로 석·박사 학위과정, 국제연수 및 국제개발협력(ODA) 사업을 활발히 운영해 왔다. 2025년 전문대학원으로 전환한 이후에는 글로벌 도시 문제 해결과 지속가능한 도시 발전을 선도할 전문인재 양성에 더욱 힘쓰고 있다.)

item.title: Finding the Key to Honam's Semiconductor Success in Kumamoto (호남 반도체 성공 열쇠, 구마모토에서 답을 찾다)
item.description:
<<>> It was at 4:27 p.m. on the 28th of last month that a magnitude 7.1 earthquake struck Kumamoto Prefecture in Japan's Kyushu region. A segment of the 2016 Kumamoto earthquake fault zone that had remained unbroken moved for the first time in a decade. Aftershocks continued 200 times over three days, and 10,000 people are enduring the extreme heat in evacuation shelters. The tremors were felt as far away as Busan and other southeastern regions of Korea, with nearly 300 reports of shaking filed, and domestic evening news broadcasts treated the well-being of the so-called "Silicon Island," considered the heart of Japan's semiconductor industry, as a major story. The region, under a heat wave exceeding 35 degrees Celsius, was hit by both power outages and water supply disruptions, forcing up to 140,000 households to endure summer nights without water. As of the 2nd, the death toll from the Kumamoto earthquake stood at 38. The human toll was heavy at industrial sites. The collapse of the chimney at Nippon Paper's Yatsushiro plant and the "AEON Mall" shopping center claimed the lives of around ten people at those two locations alone. <<> No deaths occurred at the TSMC semiconductor fab (production line), the representative of Kumamoto's new cutting-edge industry. TSMC is Taiwan's largest foundry (semiconductor contract manufacturing) company in the world. Earlier, in 2021, the Japanese government provided large-scale subsidies to attract this company's plant to Kumamoto Prefecture. Twenty hours after the earthquake, TSMC issued a brief press release stating that there were no employee casualties and no structural abnormalities in the buildings. Market analysts suggested that the Kumamoto plant accounts for less than 3% of TSMC's total production capacity, limiting the decline in its stock price. The influence of this company, which introduced Kumamoto, famous for its rice shochu, to semiconductors — the "rice of industry" — is immense. It is essentially the future of Kumamoto itself, with an estimated economic effect of 11.2 trillion yen over the next decade. <<> Although the semiconductor factory equipment was protected, the problem is that bottlenecks have emerged in the supply chain centered on these regions. Yatsushiro Port, the only port in southern Kyushu (Minami Kyushu) capable of handling high-pressure gases and chemicals for semiconductors, was paralyzed by ground liquefaction and subsidence. The Kyushu Shinkansen suffered damage in over 200 locations, halting the entire line indefinitely. When the equipment at auto parts maker Aisin Kyushu was knocked out of alignment, Toyota's three plants in Fukuoka stopped operations, and even the Tahara plant in Aichi Prefecture, which lost its parts supply, was forced to suspend production. Disruptions originating in Kyushu rippled back to the heart of Honshu. This is the same kind of supply chain risk seen in 2011, when the suspension of operations at Japanese semiconductor company Renesas's plant after the Great East Japan Earthquake led to production cuts across the global auto industry. <<> Kyushu has experienced two waves of industrial advancement. A prime example is Kitakyushu, the steel city that was a standard-bearer of heavy industry, which became Kyushu's first government-designated city (a city with special status, similar to Korea's metropolitan cities) in 1963 and reached a population of 1.07 million in 1979. However, following the decline of traditional heavy industry, the population had been slowly shrinking for a long time, and the recent reduction of core steel production infrastructure, including the conversion to electric furnaces at Nippon Steel's Yawata Works, has accelerated the decline. Around 1,150 people are set to lose their jobs or need to relocate. As of April, the population stood at 898,668, falling below the 900,000 mark for the first time since its designation. Upstream functions of manufacturing, such as R&D and engineering, have moved to metropolitan areas like Tokyo, just as they have in Korea. Despite having ten universities in the city, there is a shortage of jobs for graduates, leading young people to leave. It is Kumamoto, in southern Kyushu, that has ridden this gap to achieve a second industrial leap. With the Japanese government promising 1.2 trillion yen in subsidies to attract TSMC, the region was in the midst of building a future around advanced industry. As the world-class semiconductor company moved in, large-scale plant construction and related partners and personnel flooded the area, immediately jolting the local economy. Land prices in the adjacent towns of Ozu and Kikuyo saw the highest appreciation rates in Japan, ranking first and second nationally at 33.1% and 30.8%, respectively. JASM, a joint venture involving TSMC and Japan's Sony, posted its first quarterly profit in the first quarter (January-March) of this year, just over a year after starting mass production, and in February, the introduction of a 3-nanometer process for its second plant was announced. And then, on July 28th, Kumamoto was put to the test by the earthquake. <<> During the 2016 earthquake, Sony's Kumamoto plant, which accounted for over 40% of global image sensor market share, took more than three months to fully normalize. This time, however, operations resumed just one week after the quake, on the 4th, and production is expected to return to pre-earthquake levels by mid-August. Renesas, which took 35 days to recover in 2016, plans to complete recovery within three weeks this time, and Tokyo Electron Kyushu, which handles at this single site effectively 90% of global market share for coater/developer equipment, has cut its restart time from ten days to six. Sony's CFO attributed the early recovery to a decade of seismic reinforcement work and disaster response training conducted with partner companies. Renesas's 35-day recovery in 2016 was also a record achieved through support systems involving 90 partner companies and Toyota and Denso. <<> This network is the result of over 50 years of accumulated collaboration. It wasn't created in just four years since TSMC's groundbreaking in 2022. Kyushu has a history of industrial ecosystem agglomeration built up since the 1970s, with over 700 related business sites currently operating in cooperation. The disaster experience of 2016 was layered on top of this. The earthquake trained its governance, and that governance, which championed "creative reconstruction," became the foundation for attracting TSMC. TSMC's Arizona plant, announced in May 2020, faced delays in its production schedule due to labor union conflicts and workforce acquisition issues, only beginning mass production at the end of 2024, four and a half years after the initial announcement. <<> In contrast, the time from the November 2021 announcement of the Kumamoto plant's construction to mass production in December 2024 was three years. Given the same company, the same technology, and similar timing for the construction announcements, the difference between the two regions comes down to the regional ecosystem and the coordination capabilities of the public and private sectors. Kumamoto wasn't without conflict either. JASM's starting salary of 290,000 yen for new university graduates is 40% higher than the regional average, drawing complaints from small and medium-sized enterprises with fewer than 100 employees that couldn't keep up with the wage increases. The TSMC chairman publicly suggested delaying the start of construction for the second plant due to traffic congestion, prompting a rebuttal from the Kumamoto governor. Kumamoto responded to the increased mobility demand by introducing airport access rail and half-price bus passes. When concerns about groundwater contamination were raised, measures were put in place to recharge the aquifer with three times the amount of water used. It wasn't that there was no conflict; rather, they successfully built processes for handling conflict. <<> Looking at Kumamoto prompts reflection on Honam's semiconductor cluster. The stress Honam will face probably won't be earthquakes. Risks confronting a region arrive in different forms. If Kumamoto's vulnerability lies in fault lines, the walls Honam must overcome are drought and power grid issues. The government's plan, announced on June 30th, to supply water to the semiconductor industrial complex totals 650,000 tons per day, drawing 300,000 tons from Dongbok Dam, 50,000 tons from Juam Dam, and 100,000 tons each from the Jangheung, Boseong River, and Naju Dams. However, these figures overlap with emergency measures established during the 2022-2023 drought in Gwangju and South Jeolla Province. At that time, the Dongbok Dam reservoir level fell to 19.1%, its lowest in 14 years, Juam Dam hit a record low of 20.3%, and Gwangju came to the brink of water rationing. The water for fabs during normal times and the emergency water for drought are the same water. This reveals a structural limitation: in the face of a drought disaster, conflict over industrial and residential water use is inevitable. <<> Electricity is the opposite. Honam has surplus renewable energy but is unable to utilize it. With the power grid saturated, new grid connections have been effectively blocked since September 2023, and it was only last July that a conditional connection of 2.3 gigawatts was permitted. Because there is no network allowing locally produced electricity to be directly used by local industries, a contradiction emerges where electricity goes unused on one side while fabs facing shortages lack the power needed for operations. The key isn't the amount of power, but the infrastructure to supply it stably where it's needed. Semiconductor micro-fabrication processes are sensitive even to instantaneous power fluctuations. In 2018, a 30-minute blackout in Pyeongtaek damaged 50,000 to 60,000 NAND wafers. This is why the central government, local governments, KEPCO, and the industry must jointly address how to compensate for the instability of renewable energy and establish a stable power supply system. <<> This is the first time a semiconductor plant is being attracted to the Honam region. Honam was bypassed during the heavy chemical industrialization and the Gyeongbu-axis development, so unlike Yeongnam, it has had a shorter "time of accumulation" for regional industrial policy. If the planned four memory fabs are completed, partner companies will follow their clients down to the region. But the partner companies following their clients cannot simply establish roots in Gwangju in the same manner as in existing hubs like Giheung, Pyeongtaek, Icheon, or Cheongju, because the infrastructure and the level of industrial agglomeration within the region are different. Gwangju needs to consider effective governance for its semiconductor ecosystem. In Kumamoto's case, the semiconductor ecosystem wasn't built by local companies alone. More than half of the 84 companies that announced entry into the semiconductor business were from other regions, such as Kanto and Chubu, or were foreign companies. Even in Ozu and Kikuyo, where the fab is located, the share of business sites belonging to out-of-region companies reaches 20-25%. This means that regions concentrated with semiconductor industries saw more active inflow of external firms. <<> More difficult than nurturing local partner companies is building governance. Gwangju has already experienced the process of the agreement for Gwangju Global Motors (GGM), established under the Gwangju-type job model, wavering. There will be a strong temptation to bypass the water negotiations, power grid restructuring, and friction over community acceptance expected after a semiconductor plant is attracted, using special laws and fast tracks. Attempts to revive the 52-hour workweek exception, which was omitted from the Semiconductor Special Act, through the "Mega Special Zone Act" are already underway under the banner of deregulation. Samsung Electronics' labor union has pushed back against this. The important thing is not to fast-track past this friction. It is when experience in mediating and resolving conflict accumulates that a region gains the strength to remain unshaken by future uncertainties. <<> The reason the three mega projects — the 5 Metropolitan Regions & 3 Special Self-Governing Provinces (five ultra-wide regions, three special self-governing provinces) and the southwestern (Honam) semiconductor cluster — are difficult is not the already-known variables of water, electricity, talent, and site procurement. The point is that the process of preparing for the stresses that take different forms in each region, and building governance that earns trust both internally and externally, is extremely arduous. Japan has spent ten years, from 2016 to 2026, training for and refining its response systems through this process. That experience became the strength that reduced recovery time from three months to three weeks in the unexpected event of an earthquake. However, Japan's cooperative governance was forced upon it by disaster. Honam must begin this training on its own, without a disaster, before its first fab is even established. And the time remaining is shorter than ten years. <<> Yang Seung-hoon, Professor at Kyungnam University (Sociology) ()

item.title: Full mobilization order for greenbelt and urban idle land... Naegok-dong, Bangi-dong among candidates mentioned (그린벨트·도심 유휴부지 총동원령…내곡동·방이동 등 거론)
item.description:
Following the government's announcement of a plan to supply 60,000 homes in the Seoul metropolitan area in the January 29 measures, it is expected to announce additional supply measures for more than 50,000 homes as early as next week, drawing attention to new candidate sites. (정부가 지난 1·29 대책에서 수도권 주택 6만호 공급 계획을 밝힌 데 이어 이르면 다음주 추가로 5만호 이상 공급 대책을 발표할 예정인 가운데 신규 후보지에 관심이 쏠린다.)

According to the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport on the 4th, the government is reviewing various methods to secure land available for housing supply as quickly as possible, including lifting the development restriction zone (greenbelt) in the metropolitan area and identifying idle urban land. Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Kim Yun-deok said at the second national debate on real estate policies held on the 27th of last month, "I have developed a strong desire to build homes even if it means lifting the greenbelt designation," adding, "We will actively consider supplying housing even if it requires lifting some restrictions." Some mention Seoul Seocho-gu Naegok-dong reserve force training site and the area near Olympic Athletes' Village in Bangi-dong, Songpa-gu, as candidate sites. <<> The ministry is also thoroughly scouring idle land within urban areas. The Seoul Regional Public Procurement Service site in Seocho-gu, the Korea Land and Housing Corporation (LH) Yeouido site, and the former Gwangjin-gu Office building are among the names being floated. These were also mentioned as candidate sites in past measures such as the 'August 4 Housing Supply Measures' in 2020. Plans to convert idle urban land, such as semi-industrial zones concentrated in southwestern Seoul including Yeongdeungpo-gu and Guro-gu, into residential use are also likely to be pursued. <<> Accelerating the pace of supply measures announced in the September 7 measures last year and the January 29 measures this year is also a key task. The focus is on a 'speed war' to shorten the development period of major public housing sites in the metropolitan area—including the 3rd new towns, Taereung Golf Course in Nowon-gu, Seoul, and Gwacheon Racecourse in Gyeonggi Province—to less than half of the previous timeframe. Until apartment supply, which takes a long time, is realized, non-apartment housing is a key card to fill the supply cliff. To support the recovery of the construction industry and expand urban housing supply, the government plans to expand financial support for non-apartment construction and actively promote projects to convert vacant commercial properties and offices into housing. <<> Financial authorities are also reviewing measures with two pillars—'business financing support' and 'end-user loan support'—to improve housing supply conditions. First, they plan to expand public guarantees centered on non-apartment project sites and prepare measures to revitalize project financing (PF) by lowering funding burdens for viable projects. Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Bok-hyun emphasized at the debate on the 27th of last month, "In sectors where supply is not smooth, like non-apartments, finance should play a role in facilitating supply." <<> The Financial Services Commission is also reviewing targeted easing of loan regulations for end-users such as young people and newlyweds. This is because supply measures are only meaningful if buyers can actually receive allocation and move into homes. Support for relocation loans in redevelopment projects and final payment loans for prospective residents are also under discussion. With the broad framework of the measures set, work to specify support targets and scale, household debt management, and the impact on the soundness of the financial sector is expected to accelerate. <<> Reporter Lee Ji-hye godot@hani.co.kr Reporter Ahn Tae-ho eco@hani.co.kr ( 4일 국토교통부 등에 따르면 정부는 수도권 개발제한구역(그린벨트) 해제, 도심 유휴부지 발굴 등 주택 공급이 가능한 용지를 최대한 빠르게 확보할 각종 방법을 검토하고 있다. 김윤덕 국토부 장관은 지난달 27일 열린 두번째 부동산정책 국민 대토론회에서 “그린벨트를 해제해서라도 집을 짓고 싶다는 강한 열망이 생겼다”며 “필요하다면 일부를 해제하더라도 주택을 공급할 수 있도록 적극 고민하겠다”고 밝혔다. 일각에서는 서울 서초구 내곡동 예비군훈련장과 송파구 방이동 올림픽선수촌 인근 등이 후보지로 거론된다.)

item.title: Landlords May Inflate Jeonse Prices If They Move In… Tenants Hold Their Breath (집주인들 들어오면 전셋값 불지를라…숨죽인 세입자)
item.description:
As the government announced tax reforms that would increase the tax burden on non-resident single-homeowners, attention is sharply focused on the potential impact on the jeonse (key-money deposit) and monthly rent markets. Concerns are rising that landlords' moves to convert to actual residence in response to these tax changes could reduce the supply of jeonse and monthly rental properties, and that increased property tax burdens could be passed on to tenants through higher jeonse and rent prices. (정부가 비거주 1주택자의 세 부담을 높이는 세제 개편을 예고하면서 전월세 시장에 끼칠 영향이 초미의 관심사로 떠올랐다. 이번 세제 개편에 대응하는 집주인들의 실거주 전환 움직임이 전월세 물량 감소로 이어지고, 보유세 부담 증가분은 전월세 가격에 전가되는 것 아니냐는 우려가 나온다.)

According to real estate industry sources on the 4th, brokerages in Seoul's Gangnam area and along the Han River belt received a steady stream of inquiries from landlords who own high-priced homes leased out as jeonse or monthly rentals, asking whether they should sell or convert to owner-occupancy. A broker in Bangbae-dong, Seocho-gu, said, "Landlords who were deliberating whether to sell within this year are now seriously reviewing sales after seeing the new reform proposal," adding, "Non-resident single-homeowners facing tax pressure due to short holding periods are expected to move toward moving in themselves." ( 4일 부동산업계 말을 종합하면, 이날 서울 강남권과 한강벨트 일대 공인중개사무소에는 그동안 전월세를 놓고 고가 주택을 보유해온 집주인들이 매도와 실거주 전환 사이에서 어떻게 대응해야 할지에 관한 문의가 이어졌다. 서초구 방배동의 한 공인중개사는 “올해 안에 팔아야 하나 고민하던 집주인들은 이번 개편안 발표를 보더니 본격적으로 매도를 검토하는 중”이라며 “보유기간이 짧아 세 부담 압박을 받게 된 비거주 1주택자는 직접 들어와 살겠다는 쪽으로 움직일 전망”이라고 말했다.)

The market anticipates that the greater the share of non-resident single-homeowners who choose owner-occupancy over selling in response to the tax reforms, the larger the ripple effect on the jeonse and monthly rental markets. In fact, among owners of ultra-high-priced homes worth 3 billion won or more in Gangnam or the Han River belt, those with short holding periods are now far more likely to return to live in their properties rather than sell. Should this happen, tenants in those homes will be unable to exercise their right to request a contract renewal at lease expiry and will have to vacate, forcing them to search for new jeonse or monthly rental properties in surrounding areas, which is expected to drive up prices nearby. ( 시장에선 비거주 1주택 집주인들이 이번 세제 개편에 대한 대응으로 매도가 아닌 실거주를 선택하는 비중이 커질수록 전월세 시장에 끼칠 파장이 확대될 것으로 보고 있다. 실제로 강남권이나 한강벨트의 30억원대 이상 초고가 주택 보유자 중 보유기간이 짧은 사람은 매도보다 실거주로 돌아설 가능성이 매우 높아진 상황이다. 이렇게 되면 해당 주택의 세입자는 계약 만료 때 계약갱신청구권을 사용하지 못하고 집을 비워야 하며, 주변지역에서 새 전월세 매물을 찾아야 하는데 따라 주변 전월세 가격 상승을 불러올 것으로 예상된다. )

In response, the government explains that when non-resident single-homeowners move into their own properties, the homes they previously lived in will be supplied as new jeonse or monthly rentals, so overall supply and demand in the rental market will not see major fluctuations. There is also analysis that the impact will be limited because most demand for jeonse and monthly rentals in high-priced areas like Gangnam and the Han River belt comes from tenants with high asset and income levels. However, real estate industry insiders point out that if tenants who previously lived in high-priced jeonse properties are displaced and move to lower-priced areas, it could trigger a chain reaction of price increases. ( 이와 관련해 정부는 비거주 1주택 집주인들이 실거주로 이동할 때 그동안 살던 집은 신규 전월세로 공급되기에 전체적인 전월세 수급에는 큰 변동이 없을 것이라고 설명하고 있다. 또 강남권과 한강벨트 지역의 고가 주택 전월세 수요층의 대부분은 자산·소득수준이 높은 수요자라는 점에서 시장에 미칠 파장은 제한적일 것이라는 분석도 있다. 그러나 고가 전세를 살던 임차인이 밀려나 가격대가 낮은 곳으로 이동하면 연쇄적인 가격 상승이 빚어질 수 있다는 게 부동산 업계의 지적이다. )

In particular, industry observers expect that owners of single homes worth between 1.2 billion and 2.9 billion won, not just ultra-high-priced properties, may also rush to choose owner-occupancy to minimize property tax and capital gains tax liabilities under the new reforms. The reforms introduce a special provision that allows single-homeowners who have a residence but relocated to another city or county for unavoidable reasons such as work, schooling, medical treatment, or caring for parents to count up to three years of holding period toward the "long-term homeownership income deduction" (for capital gains tax). Consequently, such homeowners will find it advantageous to move into their own homes after the three-year holding period lapses, in which case existing tenants must vacate and relocate to new jeonse or monthly rental properties. ( 특히 부동산 업계에선 초고가 주택이 아닌 시가 12억~29억원 정도의 1주택 소유 비거주자도 이번 세제 개편에 따른 보유세와 양도소득세 절세를 위해 실거주를 선택하는 이들이 속출할 수 있다고 예상한다. 이번 세제 개편에선 거주용 주택이 있지만 직장, 취학, 질병치료, 부모봉양 등 불가피한 사정이 있어 다른 시·군으로 주거를 이전한 1주택자에 대해 최장 3년까지 보유기간을 ‘주택 장기거주 소득공제’(양도세) 적용하는 기간으로 인정하는 특례가 도입된다. 이에 따라 이에 해당하는 주택 소유자는 보유기간 3년이 지난 뒤에는 본인 집에 입주하는 게 유리해지고, 이 경우 기존 임차인은 집을 비워주고 신규 전월세로 옮겨가야 한다. )

Experts say that while encouraging owner-occupancy is desirable, a surge in moves toward actual residence before 2029—when the tax burden gap between non-resident and resident single-homeowners reaches its maximum—could destabilize the jeonse and monthly rental markets. In particular, with Seoul's apartment move-in supply at an all-time low next year (13,019 units), a combination of increased owner-occupancy and tenant evictions is expected to become a powerful upward pressure on the rental market. ( 전문가들은 실거주 장려는 바람직하지만 1주택자의 비거주와 실거주 세 부담 차이가 최대로 커지는 2029년 이전에 실거주 이동이 몰리게 되면 전월세시장 불안을 야기할 수 있다고 우려한다. 특히 서울 아파트 입주물량이 사상 최저(1만3019호)인 내년에 집주인들의 실거주 증가와 임차인 퇴거가 맞물리면 전월세시장의 강력한 상승 압력 요인이 될 것으로 보인다.)

Park Won-gap, senior real estate expert at KB Kookmin Bank, said, "In high-priced housing clusters like Gangnam, an increase in demand to 'move into my own home' makes a rise in jeonse prices inevitable," adding, "Since high jeonse deposits will become burdensome, monthly rental contracts are likely to increase." ( 박원갑 케이비(KB) 국민은행 부동산수석전문위원은 “강남을 비롯한 고가주택 밀집지역의 경우 ‘내집 가서 살자’는 수요가 늘면 전셋값 상승은 불가피하다”면서 “고액 전세가 부담이 되므로 월세 계약이 늘어날 것”이라고 내다봤다.)

Senior Reporter Choi Jong-hoon cjhoon@hani.co.kr ( 최종훈 선임기자 cjhoon@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Coupang posts 830 billion won loss in Q2…showing recovery after data leak incident (쿠팡, 2분기 8300억원 적자…유출 사고 이후 회복세)
item.description:
Coupang's U.S. parent company, Coupang Inc., posted an operating loss of 830 billion won in the second quarter. This reflects the impact of approximately 620 billion won in fines imposed in connection with the personal information leak that occurred in November last year. (쿠팡의 미국 모회사 쿠팡 아이엔씨(Inc)가 2분기 8300억원 영업적자를 기록했다. 지난해 11월 발생한 쿠팡의 개인정보 유출 사고와 관련해 부과된 과징금 약 6200억이 반영된 영향이다.)

According to the second-quarter consolidated earnings report submitted to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on the 5th by Coupang Inc., which is listed on the New York Stock Exchange, the company's second-quarter revenue stood at $8.856 billion. This is a 4% increase from the same period last year ($8.524 billion), and a 10% increase on a constant-currency basis excluding exchange rate fluctuations. Converting second-quarter revenue at the average quarterly exchange rate for the period (1,501.89 won per dollar) yields approximately 13.3007 trillion won. (미국 뉴욕 증시에 상장된 쿠팡 아이엔씨가 5일 미국 증권거래위원회(SEC)에 제출한 2분기 연결실적 보고서를 보면, 쿠팡 아이엔씨의 2분기 매출은 88억5600만달러로 집계됐다. 지난해 같은 기간(85억2400만달러)보다 4% 증가했으며, 환율 변동 영향을 제외한 고정환율 기준으로는 10% 증가했다. 2분기 매출을 같은 기간 원·달러 평균 분기 환율(1501.89원)로 환산하면 13조3007억원이다.)

Operating profit, on the other hand, deteriorated significantly. The second-quarter operating loss was $556 million (approximately 835 billion won), turning to a deficit compared with the $49 million (209.3 billion won) operating profit recorded in the same period last year. This marks the second consecutive quarter of losses, following the first quarter, which posted an operating loss of $242 million. (반면 영업이익은 크게 악화했다. 2분기 영업손실은 5억5600만달러(약 8350억원)로, 지난해 같은 기간 4900만달러(2093억원) 영업이익을 기록했던 것과 견주어 적자로 전환했다. 지난 1분기(2억4200만달러)에 이은 적자로 전환했다. 2억4200만달러의 영업손실을 기록했던 지난 1분기에 이어 2기 연속 적자다.)

Net income, which includes non-operating gains and losses and taxes, also turned to a deficit. The second-quarter net loss was $570 million (approximately 856 billion won), a swing from the $31 million net income recorded in the same period last year. (영업 외 손익과 세금까지 반영한 당기순이익도 적자로 돌아섰다. 2분기 당기순손실은 5억7000만달러(약 8560억원)로, 지난해 같은 기간 3100만달러의 당기순이익에서 적자 전환했다.)

The number of active customers for product commerce reached 24.7 million, up 3.3% from the same period last year (23.9 million). This figure also increased compared with the first quarter (23.9 million), showing signs of recovery in customer metrics that had slowed following the personal information leak incident. (프로덕트 커머스 활성 고객 수는 2470만명으로, 지난해 같은 기간(2390만명)보다 3.3% 증가했다. 지난 1분기(2390만명)와 비교해도 증가한 수치로, 개인정보 유출 사태로 둔화했던 고객 지표가 회복세를 보이는 모습이다.)

During the conference call held that day, Coupang Inc. Chairman Kim Beom-seok explained, "Most of the spending affected by the data incident has already recovered, and we are now showing the same growth trajectory as before the incident," adding, "Wow membership subscribers have surpassed pre-leak levels." However, Chairman Kim also said, "We will continue to work to win back customers who have not returned." (이날 컨퍼런스콜에서 김범석 쿠팡 아이엔씨 의장은 “데이터 사고로 영향을 받았던 지출의 대부분이 이미 회복했고 현재는 사고 발생 이전과 같은 성장 흐름을 나타내고 있다”며 “와우 멤버십 가입자는 개인정보 유출 사고 이전 수준을 넘어섰다”고 설명했다. 다만 김 의장은 “돌아오지 않은 고객들을 다시 확보하기 위해 계속해서 노력할 것”이라고 말했다.)

He also expressed confidence in the Taiwan business, a growth venture. Chairman Kim noted that dawn delivery was recently introduced in Taiwan, saying, "It took four years to launch dawn delivery in Korea, but Taiwan achieved this in just one year," and explained, "Taiwan didn't start from a blank slate, so we built the service faster than at the beginning." Chairman Kim predicted that although it is still in the early stages, Taiwan could achieve the same rapid growth as Korea. (성장사업 부문인 대만 사업에서도 자신감을 드러냈다. 김 의장은 최근 대만에서 새벽배송을 도입했다고 밝히며 “한국 새벽배송을 출시하는 데에는 4년이 걸렸지만, 대만은 불과 1년만에 이를 달성했다”며 “대만은 백지상태에서 시작한 것이 아니므로 처음보다 더 빠르게 서비스를 구축했다”고 설명했다. 김 의장은 아직 초기 단계지만 한국과 같은 빠른 성장세가 대만에서도 가능할 것으로 내다봤다.)

Meanwhile, according to the earnings report released that day, the estimated loss from the fire at Coupang's Incheon logistics center in July is $246 million. (한편, 이날 실적 보고서를 보면 지난 7월 발생한 인천 쿠팡 물류센터 화재에 따른 손실은 2억4600만달러로 추정됐다.)

item.title: Kookmin University and KOICA to Foster Palestinian AI Doctoral Researchers (국민대·KOICA, 팔레스타인 AI 박사급 연구인력 양성 추진)
item.description:
Kookmin University (President Jung Seung-ryul) Industry-Academic Cooperation Foundation and Global Development Cooperation Institute (GDCI) announced that they will operate an "AI Ph.D. Fellowship Program" jointly with the Korea International Cooperation Agency (KOICA) to cultivate core research personnel in the field of artificial intelligence (AI) in Palestine. (국민대학교(총장 정승렬) 산학협력단·글로벌개발협력연구원(GDCI)은 한국국제협력단(KOICA)과 함께 팔레스타인의 인공지능(AI) 분야 핵심 연구인력을 양성하기 위한 ‘AI Ph.D. 펠로우십 프로그램’을 운영한다고 밝혔다.)

This program is the core talent development track of the "Innovative Technology R&D Capacity Building Project for Palestine's Digital Transformation" promoted by KOICA. Along with supporting degree programs, it aims to cultivate researchers capable of addressing Palestine's pressing issues and to support them in leading local research and development and industrial innovation after they return to their home country. (이번 프로그램은 KOICA가 추진하는 ‘팔레스타인 디지털 전환을 위한 혁신기술 R&D 역량강화 사업’의 핵심 인재 양성 과정이다. 학위과정 지원과 함께 팔레스타인의 현안을 해결할 수 있는 연구인력을 양성하고, 이들이 귀국 후 현지 연구개발과 산업혁신을 주도하도록 지원하는 것을 목표로 한다.)

The "AI Ph.D. Fellowship Program" is a long-term training program that selects 30 outstanding Palestinian talents and supports their doctoral education and research in AI within Korea. Selected trainees will enroll in the doctoral program at Kookmin University's Graduate School of AI and Software, researching core AI technologies and their applications in industrial and public sectors. Research topics will be selected in connection with Palestine's major issues. Through this, the education and research process will be managed to ensure research outcomes can be utilized for solving local problems and digital transformation. (‘AI Ph.D. 펠로우십 프로그램’은 팔레스타인의 우수 인재 30명을 선발해 국내에서 AI 분야 박사과정 교육과 연구개발을 지원하는 장기 연수 프로그램이다. 선발된 연수생들은 국민대 AI·SW대학원 박사과정에 진학해 AI 핵심기술과 산업·공공 분야 응용기술을 연구하게 된다. 연구 주제는 팔레스타인의 주요 현안과 연계해 선정할 예정이다. 이를 통해 연구 결과가 현지의 문제 해결과 디지털 전환에 활용될 수 있도록 교육과 연구과정을 운영한다.)

During their doctoral studies, trainees will participate in AI major coursework, joint research with Korean researchers, industry-academia collaboration projects, internships, presentations at international academic conferences, and technology commercialization programs. Through these activities, the program plans to help them build research capabilities, field problem-solving skills, project planning and management competencies, and international research networks. (연수생들은 박사과정 동안 AI 전공교육을 비롯해 국내 연구진과의 공동연구, 산학협력 프로젝트, 인턴십, 국제학술대회 발표, 기술사업화 프로그램 등에 참여한다. 이를 통해 연구 역량과 현장 문제해결 능력, 프로젝트 기획·관리 역량, 국제 연구 네트워크를 갖추도록 지원할 계획이다.)

The most distinctive feature of this program is that, unlike general support programs focused solely on degree acquisition, it is designed for trainees to return to Palestine after completing their degrees and work within the local innovation ecosystem. Upon returning, trainees will serve as research personnel connecting universities, research institutions, and industry, taking on roles that support R&D outcomes being translated into products, services, and startups. (이번 프로그램의 가장 큰 특징은 학위 취득에 초점을 둔 일반적인 지원사업과 달리, 연수생들이 학위 취득 이후 팔레스타인으로 귀국해 현지 혁신 생태계에서 활동하도록 설계됐다는 점이다. 연수생들은 귀국 후 대학과 연구기관, 산업계를 연결하는 연구인력으로 활동하며 연구개발 성과가 제품과 서비스, 창업 등으로 이어질 수 있도록 지원하는 역할을 맡게 된다.)

This program is also linked to Kookmin University's mid-to-long-term development strategy "KMU VISION 2035: EDGE," which the university is pursuing on the occasion of its 80th anniversary. Kookmin University has selected AI+X as one of its eight specialization areas and is expanding education and research that combines artificial intelligence with various fields such as industry, healthcare, education, and public services. Through this program, the university plans to connect the educational and research capabilities of the Graduate School of AI and Software with international development cooperation and build an AI researcher training model that contributes to solving Palestine's issues and its digital transformation. (이번 프로그램은 국민대가 개교 80주년을 맞아 추진하는 중장기 발전전략 ‘KMU VISION 2035: EDGE’와도 연계된다. 국민대는 AI+X를 8대 특성화 분야 중 하나로 선정하고, 인공지능을 산업·보건의료·교육·공공서비스 등 다양한 분야와 결합하는 교육과 연구를 확대하고 있다. 이번 프로그램을 통해 AI·SW대학원의 교육·연구 역량을 국제개발협력과 연계하고, 팔레스타인의 현안 해결과 디지털 전환에 기여할 수 있는 AI 연구인력 양성 모델을 구축할 계획이다.)

Cho Hyun-kyu, Director of KOICA's Palestine Office, stated, "The AI Ph.D. Fellowship is a program that goes beyond merely providing outstanding Palestinian talents with opportunities to earn degrees; it lays the foundation for them to lead local R&D and digital transformation after returning home." He added, "I expect Korea's AI research and education experience to serve as a catalyst for promoting sustainable digital innovation in Palestine." (조현규 KOICA 팔레스타인 사무소장은 “AI Ph.D. 펠로우십은 팔레스타인의 우수 인재에게 학위 취득 기회를 제공하는 데 그치지 않고, 이들이 귀국 후 현지 연구개발과 디지털 전환을 주도할 수 있는 기반을 조성하는 프로그램”이라며 “한국의 AI 연구와 교육 경험이 팔레스타인의 지속가능한 디지털 혁신을 촉진하는 마중물이 되기를 기대한다”고 밝혔다.)

Professor Lee Sang-hwan of Kookmin University's School of Software, who serves as the Program Manager (PM), said, "The greatest strength of Kookmin University's Graduate School of AI and Software is its AX (AI Transformation)-centered education system, which extends AI beyond research and software implementation into real systems and industrial fields such as industrial innovation, healthcare, education, and public services." He added, "I will support the program's outcomes so they lead to improved public services, youth job creation, industrial innovation, and digital transformation in Palestine." (사업책임(PM)을 맡은 이상환 국민대 소프트웨어학부 교수는 “국민대 AI·SW대학원의 가장 큰 강점은 AI를 연구나 소프트웨어 구현에 한정하지 않고 산업혁신, 보건의료, 교육 및 공공서비스 등 실제 시스템과 산업 현장으로 확장하는 AX(AI Transformation) 중심의 교육체계”라며, “프로그램의 성과가 팔레스타인의 공공서비스 개선과 청년 일자리 창출, 산업혁신과 디지털 전환으로 이어질 수 있도록 지원하겠다”고 말했다.)

item.title: KOSPI Surges 4% at Opening... 45th Sidecar Triggered This Year (코스피 4% 급등 출발…올해 45번째 사이드카 발동)
item.description:
The KOSPI is showing a 4% upswing from early trading on the 5th. This appears to be driven by an overall improvement in risk appetite across global stock markets, as U.S. big tech and semiconductor stocks soared overnight. (코스피가 5일 장 초반부터 4% 상승세를 나타내고 있다. 글로벌 주식시장에서 전반적으로 위험선호 심리가 개선되며 간밤 미국 빅테크(거대 기술기업)·반도체 종목이 급등한 영향으로 보인다.)

On this day, the KOSPI opened at 6,603.48, up 3.85% from the previous day, and is widening its gains. After surging 17.91% on the 31st of last month, the index had shown weakness for two consecutive days, but it is now back on an upward trajectory. (이날 코스피는 전날보다 3.85% 오른 6603.48에 출발해 상승 폭을 넓히고 있다. 코스피는 지난달 31일 17.91% 급등한 뒤 연이틀 약세를 보였지만, 재차 상승세를 타는 분위기다.)

The KOSPI 200 futures index also rose more than 5% from the previous day, triggering a buy-sidecar that halted program buy orders for five minutes at 9:24 a.m. This marks the 45th buy or sell sidecar this year. ( 코스피200선물 지수도 전날 대비 5% 이상 오르며 오전 9시24분 프로그램 매수호가를 5분간 정지하는 매수 사이드카가 발동됐다. 올해 들어 45번째 매수·매도 사이드카다.)

Top market-cap stocks on the main bourse were all flashing red lights. As of 9:10 a.m., Samsung Electronics was trading at 250,000 won, up 4.17% from the previous day, and SK Hynix was trading at 1,661,000 won, up 5.33%. SK Square and Samsung Electro-Mechanics were also surging 7.83% and 10.55%, respectively. (유가증권시장 시가총액 상위 종목이 일제히 빨간불을 켰다. 오전 9시10분 기준 삼성전자는 전날보다 4.17% 오른 25만원, 에스케이(SK)하이닉스는 5.33% 오른 166만1000원에 거래되고 있다. 에스케이(SK)스퀘어와 삼성전기도 각각 7.83%, 10.55% 급등하고 있다.)

This appears to be due to easing U.S.-Iran tensions, which sent oil prices and interest rates tumbling, along with strong big tech earnings, improving investor sentiment toward artificial intelligence (AI)-related sectors. On U.S. markets, related stocks such as Palantir (+29.45%), Nvidia (+2.56%), Micron (+7.62%), and SanDisk (+10.84%) soared, and the tech-heavy Nasdaq index rose 2.59%, reflecting a favorable breeze. The S&P 500 index and the Dow Jones Industrial Average also rose 1.71% and 1.79%, respectively, hitting record highs. (미-이란 갈등이 점차 완화되며 유가·금리가 급락하고 빅테크 실적이 호조를 보이며, 인공지능(AI) 관련 업종에 대한 투자심리가 개선됐기 때문으로 보인다. 미국 증시에서도 팔란티어(+29.45%), 엔비디아(+2.56%), 마이크론(+7.62%), 샌디스크(+10.84%) 등 관련 종목이 급등하고, 기술주 중심의 나스닥 지수가 2.59% 오르는 등 훈풍이 불었다. 스탠더드앤드푸어스(S&P)500 지수와 다우존스30산업평균 지수도 각각 1.71%, 1.79% 상승하며 최고치를 기록했다.)

The KOSDAQ index opened at 794.93, up 1.82% from the previous day, continuing its rally for a fourth consecutive trading day. (코스닥 지수는 전날보다 1.82% 오른 794.93에 출발해 4거래일 연속 상승장을 이어가고 있다.)

item.title: Chung-Ang University Develops Bio-Based Multifunctional Thermal Management Composite Integrating Insulation, Heat Storage, and Flame Retardancy (중앙대, 단열·열저장·난연 성능 통합한 바이오기반 다기능 열관리 복합소재 개발)
item.description:
Researchers at Chung-Ang University have developed a multifunctional thermal management composite material that can be used to enhance the fire safety of electric vehicles and large-scale energy storage systems. (중앙대학교 연구진이 전기자동차와 대규모 에너지저장장치의 화재 안전성을 높이는 데 활용할 수 있는 다기능 열관리 복합소재를 개발했다.)

A research team led by Professor Juheon Kim of the Department of Chemical Engineering and the Department of Intelligent Energy and Industry Convergence at Chung-Ang University announced the development of a "thermal management composite material" that combines bio-based aerogel, which suppresses heat transfer, with phase-change materials that absorb and store heat, achieving thermal insulation, thermal energy storage, leakage resistance, structural stability, and flame-retardant performance simultaneously. (중앙대 화학공학과 겸 지능형에너지산업융합학과 김주헌 교수 연구팀은 열전달을 억제하는 바이오 기반의 에어로겔과 열을 흡수·저장하는 상변화 소재를 결합해 단열, 열에너지 저장, 누출 저항성, 구조적 안정성, 난연 성능을 동시에 갖춘 열관리 복합소재’를 개발했다고 밝혔다.)

Combining "thermal insulation" and "latent heat" to address battery thermal runaway (배터리 열폭주 대응 위한 ‘단열’과 ‘잠열’의 결합)

Lithium-ion batteries used in electric vehicles and energy storage systems (ESS) can generate excessive heat during charging/discharging or due to internal short circuits. If this heat rapidly transfers to adjacent cells, it can lead to cascading temperature rises and thermal runaway accompanied by fire. (전기자동차와 에너지저장장치(ESS)에 사용되는 리튬이온 배터리는 충·방전이나 내부 단락으로 과도한 열이 발생할 수 있다. 이 열이 인접한 셀로 빠르게 전달되면 연쇄적인 온도 상승과 화재를 동반하는 열폭주로 이어질 수 있다.)

To prevent this, insulation materials such as polymer foams, ceramic fibers, and aerogels have been used, but existing materials only slow heat transfer and have limitations in directly absorbing the heat generated internally. On the other hand, phase-change materials can absorb latent heat during the transition from solid to liquid, mitigating temperature rises, but they suffer from leakage and structural damage issues when liquefied. (이를 막기 위해 고분자 폼, 세라믹 섬유, 에어로겔 등의 단열재가 활용되어 왔지만 기존 소재는 열전달을 늦출 뿐 내부에서 발생한 열을 직접 흡수하기 어렵다는 한계가 있다. 반면 상변화 소재는 고체에서 액체로 변하는 과정에서 잠열을 흡수해 온도 상승을 완화할 수 있으나, 액상화에 따른 누출과 구조 손상 문제가 뒤따랐다.)

To address these limitations, the research team combined the insulating function of aerogels with the latent heat storage function of phase-change materials into a single composite, designed to slow heat propagation while simultaneously absorbing generated heat and suppressing the inevitable leakage that occurs during the phase-change process. (연구팀은 이러한 한계를 해결하기 위해 에어로겔의 단열 기능과 상변화 소재의 잠열 저장 기능을 하나의 복합소재에 결합했고 이를 통해 열의 전파를 늦추는 동시에 발생한 열을 흡수함과 동시에 상변화 과정에서 필연적으로 발생하는 누액 현상까지 억제할 수 있도록 설계되었다.)

Expected to be used as a multifunctional thermal management material for EVs and ESS (전기차·ESS용 다기능 열관리 소재로 활용 기대)

This research is significant in that it goes beyond the limitations of conventional insulation materials, which merely block heat transfer, by using phase-change materials to absorb and store heat while also reducing leakage and fire risks at high temperatures. (이번 연구는 단순히 열의 전달을 막는 기존 단열재의 한계를 넘어, 상변화 소재를 이용해 열을 흡수·저장하고 고온에서의 누출과 화재 위험까지 함께 줄였다는 점에서 의미가 있다.)

In particular, by integrating the insulating properties of bio-based HEC/LGN aerogel, the latent heat storage capability of erythritol, and the structural reinforcement and flame-retardant effects of ZnO into a single composite, it is expected to serve as a thermal management material capable of delaying rapid heat transfer between cells and mitigating temperature rises in electric vehicle battery modules and packs, as well as large-scale energy storage systems (ESS). (특히 바이오 기반 HEC/LGN 에어로겔의 단열 특성, 에리트리톨의 잠열 저장 능력, ZnO의 구조 보강 및 난연 효과를 하나의 복합소재에 통합함으로서 전기자동차 배터리 모듈과 팩, 대규모 에너지저장장치(ESS)등에서 셀 사이의 급격한 열전달을 지연하고 온도 상승을 완화할 수 있는 열관리 소재로 활용될 가능성이 기대된다.)

The research findings were published in the internationally renowned chemical engineering journal "Chemical Engineering Journal" (Impact Factor 12.5) under the title "Zinc oxide-integrated hydroxyethyl cellulose/lignin aerogel–epoxy/erythritol composite for multifunctional thermal insulation." (연구 결과는 ‘다기능성 열 절연을 위한 산화아연 도입 하이드록시에틸 셀룰로오스/리그닌 에어로겔–에폭시/에리트리톨 복합소재(Zinc oxide-integrated hydroxyethyl cellulose/lignin aerogel–epoxy/erythritol composite for multifunctional thermal insulation)’라는 제목으로 화학공학 분야의 권위 있는 국제 학술지 ‘Chemical Engineering Journal’(Impact Factor 12.5) 게재되었다.)

item.title: From Online Education to On-Site Training... Sookmyung Women's University Enhances Digital and Entrepreneurship Capabilities of 110 Female Students in Three ASEAN Countries (온라인 교육부터 현지 실습까지…숙명여대, 아세안 3개국 여학생 110명 디지털·창업 역량 키운다)
item.description:
Sookmyung Women's University (President Moon Si-yeon) conducted hands-on training for 110 female students from partner universities in Laos, Cambodia, and Vietnam to strengthen their digital literacy and employment and entrepreneurship capabilities. (숙명여자대학교(총장 문시연)가 라오스·캄보디아·베트남 협력대학 여학생 110명을 대상으로 디지털 활용 능력과 취·창업 역량 강화를 위한 실무형 교육을 진행했다.)

The Asia-Pacific Center for Women's Information and Communication at Sookmyung Women's University operated the '2026 Women in Digital & Entrepreneurship (WiDE) Capacity-Building Program' over the course of one month. (숙명여대 아태여성정보통신원은 '2026 디지털 및 창업 여성역량강화 교육(Women in Digital & Entrepreneurship, WiDE)'을 한 달간 운영했다.)

()

This training is a core program of the UNESCO UNITWIN project, implemented by the Asia-Pacific Center for Women's Information and Communication, a UNESCO Chair institution, as part of the Ministry of Education's Official Development Assistance (ODA). This year, three universities participated: Souphanouvong University in Laos, the Royal University of Phnom Penh in Cambodia, and Quy Nhon University in Vietnam. (이번 교육은 유네스코 석좌 수행기관인 아태여성정보통신원이 교육부 ODA의 일환으로 추진하는 유네스코 유니트윈(UNITWIN) 사업의 핵심 프로그램이다. 올해에는 라오스 수파누봉대학교, 캄보디아 왕립프놈펜대학교, 베트남 퀴논대학교 등 3개 대학이 참여했다.)

()

A key feature of this program is the newly introduced step-by-step blended learning system that connects online education, on-site training, and career development activities. Students build foundational skills through online education, complete advanced training tailored to each country's industrial characteristics through on-site practice, and are then supported in expanding their learning outcomes into employment and entrepreneurship capabilities through career development activities. (이번 프로그램은 온라인 교육, 현지 교육, 진로개발 활동으로 이어지는 단계별 블렌디드 러닝(Blended Learning) 체계를 새롭게 도입한 것이 특징이다. 학생들이 온라인 교육을 통해 기초 역량을 쌓고 현지 실습을 통해 국가별 산업 특성에 맞는 심화 교육을 이수한 뒤, 진로개발 활동을 통해 교육 성과를 취·창업 역량으로 확장할 수 있도록 지원한다.)

()

During the training conducted in June and July, students completed three weeks of online foundational education, learning core concepts in digital and entrepreneurship fields such as Python programming, data visualization, and entrepreneurship basics. This was followed by one week of on-site training featuring advanced coursework and hands-on practice reflecting each country's industrial characteristics and policy needs, including agriculture (Laos), tourism (Cambodia), and digital/AI (Vietnam). (먼저 6~7월 중 진행된 교육 과정에서 학생들은 3주간의 온라인 기초교육을 통해 파이썬 프로그래밍, 데이터 시각화, 창업 기초 등 디지털·창업 분야의 핵심 개념을 학습했다. 이후 1주간 진행된 현지 교육에서는 농업(라오스), 관광(캄보디아), 디지털·AI(베트남) 등 각국의 산업 특성과 정책 수요를 반영한 심화 교육과 실습이 이뤄졌다.)

KAO SOKLENG, a student from the Royal University of Phnom Penh in Cambodia who participated in the on-site training, shared her thoughts: "Data analysis is the field I've always been most interested in, and through this training I was able to broaden my understanding of data analysis even further. Based on what I learned in this program, I hope to enter the data analysis field and achieve the career I've dreamed of." (현지 교육에 참여한 캄보디아 왕립프놈펜대학교의 카오 속렝(KAO SOKLENG) 학생은 "데이터 분석은 평소 가장 관심 있는 분야로, 이번 교육을 통해 데이터 분석에 대한 이해를 더욱 넓힐 수 있었다"며 "이번 프로그램에서 배운 내용을 바탕으로 향후 데이터 분석 분야로 진출해 꿈꾸던 직업을 이루고 싶다"고 소감을 밝혔다.)

()

The Asia-Pacific Center for Women's Information and Communication plans to support follow-up career development activities for outstanding graduates by October, in collaboration with partner universities' industry-academia cooperation centers, startup support organizations, and local businesses. Through corporate field trips, meetings with local startup CEOs, and employment consulting, the center aims to build a sustainable cooperation foundation where education, industry engagement, and career development create a virtuous cycle. (아태여성정보통신원은 오는 10월까지 협력대학 산학협력센터, 창업지원기관, 현지 기업 등과 함께 우수 수료생을 대상으로 후속 진로개발활동을 지원할 예정이다. 기업 필드트립, 현지 스타트업 CEO 간담회, 취업 컨설팅 등을 통해 교육과 산업 현장, 진로개발이 선순환하는 지속 가능한 협력 기반을 구축한다는 계획이다.)

Dr. Nguyen Van Thang, the UNITWIN program coordinator at Quy Nhon University in Vietnam, stated, "The greatest strength of the WiDE program is that it is a practice-oriented education that allows students to apply AI and digital technologies to real projects. It is especially meaningful in that female students build confidence and leadership through team projects and can enhance their employment competitiveness based on their digital capabilities." (베트남 퀴논대학교의 유니트윈 프로그램 총괄 담당자인 응우옌 반 땅(Nguyen Van Thang) 박사는 "WiDE 프로그램은 AI와 디지털 기술을 실제 프로젝트에 적용할 수 있는 실무 중심 교육이라는 점이 가장 큰 강점"이라며 "특히 여학생들이 팀 프로젝트를 수행하며 자신감과 리더십을 기르고, 디지털 역량을 바탕으로 취업 경쟁력을 높일 수 있다는 점에서 의미가 크다"고 밝혔다.)

()

Lee Sook-jung, Director of the Asia-Pacific Center for Women's Information and Communication, stated, "We will continue to provide practical training that reflects the industrial characteristics and educational needs of partner countries, supporting students in acquiring digital and entrepreneurship capabilities they can use in the field and connecting these to employment and entrepreneurship opportunities." <<>> (이숙정 아태여성정보통신원장은 "앞으로도 협력국의 산업 특성과 교육 수요를 반영한 실무형 교육을 통해 학생들이 현장에서 활용할 수 있는 디지털·창업 역량을 갖추고, 이를 취·창업과 연결할 수 있도록 지속적으로 지원하겠다"고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Youth Pizza Fined 200 Million Won for Passing Delivery Fees onto Franchisees (소비자가 낼 배달비 가맹점에 부담 전가한 청년피자에 과징금 2억원)
item.description:
Youth Pizza, which forced franchisees to bear the full cost of consumer delivery fees and imposed excessive penalties for mid-contract termination, has been fined approximately 200 million won by the Fair Trade Commission. (소비자가 내는 배달비 전액을 가맹점이 부담하도록 강제하고, 가맹계약 중도 해지 등에 과도한 위약금을 부과한 청년피자가 공정거래위원회로부터 약 2억원의 과징금을 부과받았다.)

The FTC announced on the 5th that it would impose corrective orders—including orders to prevent recurrence, notification orders, and orders to delete or amend contract clauses—along with a fine of 197 million won on BSB Food, the franchisor of Youth Pizza. ( 공정위는 5일 청년피자의 가맹본부인 비에스비푸드에 재발 방지 명령, 통지 명령, 계약조항 삭제·수정 명령 등 시정명령과 과징금 1억9700만원을 부과한다고 밝혔다.)

According to the FTC's investigation, starting around March 2021, BSB Food included a special clause in franchise agreements that set consumer-paid delivery fees at 0 won for all delivery orders made through delivery platforms. The clause was later revised to 0 won for the basic distance (1.5 km) with an additional 100 won per 100 meters, and remained in effect until January 2025. The investigation found that BSB Food checked compliance with the clause and sent certified notices warning that violators could face disadvantages such as contract termination or refusal to renew, thereby coercing franchisees to comply. The FTC explained, "The 0-won delivery fee clause, which the franchisor framed as a way to boost franchisee sales, was in fact an unfair practice that reduced franchisees' operating profits, and we have taken action based on this finding." ( 공정위 조사 결과, 비에스비푸드는 2021년 3월께부터 가맹계약서를 작성할 때 배달 플랫폼 등을 통한 모든 배달 주문에 대해 소비자 부담 배달비를 0원으로 설정하는 특약을 포함한 것으로 나타났다. 해당 특약 내용은 기본거리(1.5㎞) 배달비 0원에 100m당 100원 추가 등으로 변경되면서 2025년 1월까지 유지됐다. 비에스비푸드는 특약 이행 여부를 점검한 뒤 위반 사업자에 계약 해지, 갱신 거절 등 불이익이 있을 수 있다는 내용증명을 보내는 등 가맹점에 특약을 준수하도록 강제한 것으로 조사됐다. 공정위는 “가맹본부가 가맹점사업자의 매출 증대를 위한 것처럼 포장한 배달비 0원 특약이 실제로는 가맹점의 영업이익 감소를 초래한 부당한 행위임을 입증해 조처했다”고 설명했다.)

BSB Food was also found to have imposed excessive penalties on franchisees who purchased designated items through other channels (self-purchasing) or terminated their contracts mid-term. The investigation revealed that BSB Food imposed a total of 1.11 billion won in penalties across 26 instances between July 2021 and November 2024. After notifying franchisees of the penalties, the company enforced payment by suspending product supplies, setting additional special clauses, or filing civil lawsuits. While the scale of franchisees' self-purchasing ranged from as little as 5,100 won to 114,000 won per case, the penalties actually paid ranged from 3 million to 20 million won. The FTC determined that "the penalty amounts were excessive relative to the loss in operating profits." ( 비에스비푸드는 가맹점사업자가 지정 품목을 다른 경로로 구입(자점매입)하거나 중도에 계약을 해지하는 경우 과도한 위약금을 부과하기도 한 것으로 나타났다. 비에스비푸드는 2021년 7월부터 2024년 11월까지 총 26차례에 걸쳐 위약금 11억1000만원을 부과한 것으로 조사됐다. 위약금 부과를 통보한 뒤 미납하면 물품 공급 중단, 추가 특약 설정, 민사소송 제기 등으로 이행을 강제하기도 했다. 가맹점사업자의 자점매입 규모는 건당 5100원~11만4000원에 불과했는데, 실제 납입된 위약금은 300만~2000만원에 달했다. 공정위는 “영업이익 손실 규모에 비해 과중한 위약금 규모”라고 판단했다.)

Additionally, the franchisor was found to have failed to comply with statutory requirements regarding the disclosure document, as it did not properly provide the disclosure document to prospective franchisees at least 14 days before signing the franchise agreement. ( 이 밖에 가맹본부는 가맹희망자에게 가맹계약 체결 14일 전까지 정보공개서를 제공해야 하는데, 비에스비푸드는 이 기한을 제대로 지키지 않는 등 정보공개서 제공과 관련한 법정사항도 준수하지 않은 것으로 조사됐다.)

Reporter Kim Yoon-joo kyj@hani.co.kr ( 김윤주 기자 kyj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Foreign Tourism Boosts Economic Growth Rate by 0.15 Percentage Points (외국인 관광, 경제성장률 0.15%p 높여)
item.description:
It has been analyzed that spending by foreign tourists while traveling in South Korea raises the country's annual economic growth rate by about 0.15 percentage points. Compared to the government's growth forecast of 3.0% for this year, this is about one-twentieth of that level. (외국인 관광객이 한국을 여행하며 쓰는 소비가 우리나라의 연간 경제성장률을 0.15%포인트가량 높이는 것으로 분석됐다. 정부의 올해 성장률 전망치 3.0%에 견주면 20분의 1 수준이다.)

The Bank of Korea, in its issue analysis report "Economic Effects of the Tourism Industry from the Perspective of Service Exports and Policy Directions" released on the 5th, stated, "As a result of estimating the contribution of tourism exports to our economic growth since 2000, the direct and indirect contribution to the gross domestic product (GDP) growth rate averaged 0.04 percentage points per year, and during 2022–2025, when demand for visiting Korea fully recovered, it rose to an average of 0.15 percentage points per year." Here, tourism exports refer to foreign exchange earnings generated by foreign tourists entering the country and consuming services and goods such as accommodation, food, shopping, and transportation. ( 한국은행은 5일 내놓은 이슈 분석 보고서 ‘서비스수출 관점에서 본 관광산업의 경제효과와 정책 방향’을 통해 “2000년 이후 관광수출이 우리 경제성장에 기여한 효과를 시산한 결과, 국내총생산(GDP) 성장률에 대한 직·간접 기여도는 연평균 0.04%포인트로 나타났으며, 방한 수요가 본격적으로 회복된 2022∼2025년에는 연평균 0.15%포인트로 높아졌다”고 밝혔다. 여기서 관광수출이란 외국인 관광객이 국내에 입국해 숙박·음식·쇼핑·교통 등 서비스와 상품을 소비하는 데 따른 외화 획득을 뜻한다.)

About 60% of the total contribution to growth is generated directly in tourism-related businesses such as accommodation, food, and transport, while the remaining 40% is shown to occur in backward-linked industries that supply intermediate goods and services to these sectors. Last year, the number of foreign tourists visiting South Korea reached 18.94 million, exceeding the pre-pandemic peak (17.5 million in 2019) and expanding rapidly. ( 전체 성장 기여도의 약 60%는 숙박·음식·운송 등 관광 관련 사업에서 직접 발생하고, 나머지 40%는 이들 산업에 중간재와 서비스를 공급하는 후방 연관 산업에서 나타난 것으로 분석됐다. 지난 한해 우리나라를 방문한 외국인 관광객 수는 1894만명으로 팬데믹 이전 최고치(2019년 1750만명)를 넘어서며 빠르게 확대됐다.)

It was analyzed that for South Korea's tourism exports relative to its gross domestic product (1.17% in 2025) to reach Japan's level (1.46%), tourism export revenue would need to increase by 25.4% (US$5.56 billion) compared to 2025. According to the Bank of Korea, the resulting domestic value-added inducement would be US$4.4 billion (6.3 trillion won), equivalent to 0.235% of the 2025 nominal GDP. Japan has been evaluated as having achieved results in both quantitative expansion and qualitative advancement in its tourism industry since fully implementing its tourism-based national policy in 2003. ( 우리나라의 국내총생산 대비 관광수출 규모(2025년 1.17%)가 일본 수준(1.46%)에 도달하기 위해선 관광수출액이 2025년에 견줘 25.4%(55억6천만달러) 늘어야 하는 것으로 분석됐다. 이에 따른 국내 부가가치 유발액은 44억달러(원화 6조3천억원)로 2025년 명목 국내총생산의 0.235% 수준이라고 한은은 밝혔다. 일본은 2003년 관광입국 정책을 본격화한 이후 관광산업에서 양적 확대와 질적 고도화 모두에서 성과를 거둔 것으로 평가됐다.)

Jeong Seon-young, head of the Asia-Pacific Economy Team at the Bank of Korea's Research Department, stated, "Scenario analysis showed that to expand the scale of tourism exports, rather than simply increasing the number of visitors to Korea, it is more effective to increase both spending per person and length of stay simultaneously, which also alleviates policy burdens." For example, achieving the policy target (based on Japan's level) through visitor numbers alone would require attracting 4.81 million more visitors than last year. In this case, the ratio of visitors to the total population would rise from 37% to about 50%, potentially creating overtourism problems seen in countries such as Spain and Italy. Spending per person per day would need to increase by US$45.2, from US$177.8 to US$223, and the average length of stay would need to be extended by 1.7 days, from 6.5 days to 8.2 days. ( 정선영 한은 조사국 아태경제팀장은 “시나리오 분석 결과, 관광수출 규모를 확대하기 위해선 단순히 방한객 수만을 늘리기보다, 지출금액과 체류기간도 동시에 늘리는 것이 효과적이고 정책적 부담을 완화하는 방법으로 나타났다”고 밝혔다. 예컨대 방한객 수만으로 정책 목표(일본 기준)를 달성하려면 지난해보다 481만명 더 늘려야 한다. 이 경우 총인구 대비 방한객 비율이 37%에서 50%가량으로 높아져 스페인, 이탈리아 등지에서 나타나는 오버투어리즘(과잉 관광) 문제가 생겨날 수 있다는 설명이다. 1인당 1일 지출금액은 177.8달러에서 223달러로 45.2달러, 평균 체류일수는 6.5일에서 8.2일로 1.7일 연장해야 한다. )

Team leader Jeong stated, "If multiple policy variables are increased together, the required adjustments decrease significantly. For instance, even if the average length of stay is kept at the current level of 6.5 days, the benchmark (policy target) can be reached by increasing the number of visitors by 2.26 million and raising average daily spending by US$21.3." He added, "Furthermore, even if tourism export revenue remains the same, guiding visitor spending toward high-value sectors such as medical services could further boost domestic value-added." ( 정선영 팀장은 “여러 정책 변수를 함께 늘리면 조정 폭은 크게 감소한다”며 ”예를 들어 평균 체류일수는 현재 수준인 6.5일로 유지하더라도 방한객 수를 226만명 늘리고 1일 평균 지출을 21.3달러 높이면 벤치마크(정책 목표)에 도달할 수 있다”고 밝혔다. 또 관광수출액이 동일하더라도 방한객의 지출 구조를 의료 등 고가가치 분야로 유도하면 국내 부가가치를 추가로 높일 수 있을 것”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Kim Young-bae, Senior Correspondent kimyb@hani.co.kr ( 김영배 선임기자 kimyb@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Employment among older adults surpasses 10 million…‘cost of living’ reasons decline, ‘enjoyment’ rises (고령층 취업 천만 돌파…‘생활비 이유’ 줄고 ‘즐거움’ 늘어)
item.description:
The number of employed older adults in South Korea has surpassed 10 million for the first time ever. Among reasons for wanting to work, the share citing “helps with living expenses” has declined for five consecutive years, while “enjoyment of working” has increased. (국내 고령층 취업자 수가 사상 처음 1000만명을 돌파했다. 일하고 싶은 이유에 대해 최근 5년 연속 ‘생활비에 보탬이 된다’는 사유는 감소했고, ‘일하는 즐거움’은 늘었다.)

According to the “May 2026 Supplementary Survey of the Economically Active Population: Older Adults,” released by the National Data Office on the 5th, the number of employed people aged 55–79 stood at 10.125 million, up 345,000 from a year earlier, crossing the 10 million mark for the first time. The employment rate was 59.5%, the same as a year earlier. (국가데이터처가 5일 발표한 ‘2026년 5월 경제활동인구조사 고령층 부가조사 결과’를 보면, 55~79살 고령층 취업자 수는 1012만5천명으로 1년 전보다 34만5천명 늘어나 사상 처음으로 1000만명 선을 넘어섰다. 고용률은 59.5%로 1년 전과 같은 수준이다.)

Seven out of ten older adults (69.2%) said they want to work in the future, but signs of change are emerging in their reasons. Among those who answered “desire to work in the future,” the top reason was “helping with living expenses” (53.4%), accounting for more than half, but this has steadily declined from 57.1% in 2022, dropping 3.4 percentage points. Meanwhile, the second-ranked reason, “enjoyment of working,” was chosen by 36.7%, up 2 percentage points from 34.7% five years ago. In addition, the share of older adults who want to work for purposes such as “being needed by society,” “maintaining health,” or “relieving boredom”—goals related to improving quality of life and self-fulfillment—has risen overall. (고령층 10명 중 7명(69.2%)는 장래 일하기를 원하는 것으로 나타났지만, 사유에는 변화의 조짐이 포착되고 있다. ‘장래 희망 근로’를 답한 이들의 사유 1위는 ‘생활비에 보탬’(53.4%)으로 과반을 차지했지만, 2022년(57.1%) 이후 꾸준히 하락하며 3.4%포인트 내렸다. 반면 2위 사유인 ‘일하는 즐거움’을 선택한 응답은 36.7%를 기록하며, 5년 전(34.7%)보다 2%포인트 올랐다. 이 밖에 ‘사회가 필요로 함’이나 ‘건강 유지’, ‘무료함 해소’ 등 삶의 질 향상과 자아실현을 목적으로 일을 원하는 고령층의 비중이 전반적으로 상승했다.)

Regarding this shift, Kim Rak-hyeon, head of the Employment Statistics Division at the Data Office, explained, “It appears to reflect various factors, including the expansion of social security systems such as pension benefits, and an increase in older adults with better health management, which has improved conditions for working longer.” Indeed, the share of older adults receiving pensions also reached 52.7%, steadily rising from 48.4% five years ago. The average pension amount also increased by 28% over the same period, from 690,000 won to 880,000 won per month. (이런 변화에 대해 김락현 데이터처 고용통계과장은 “연금 혜택 등 사회보장체계가 확대됐고, 건강 관리가 잘 된 고령층이 증가하며 오래 일할 수 있는 여건이 좋아지는 등 다양한 이유가 반영된 것으로 보인다”고 설명했다. 실제 고령층 중 연금 수령자 비중도 52.7%로, 5년 전(48.4%)보다 꾸준히 확대됐다. 평균 연금 수령액도 같은 기간 월 69만원에서 88만원으로 28% 늘었다.)

Among those wishing to work in the future, the most important criteria for job selection were “workload and working hours” (30.8%), followed by wage level (20.3%) and the possibility of continued employment (16.3%). Regarding desired wage levels, men most frequently cited 3 million won or more (34.9%), while women most frequently cited 1 million to less than 1.5 million won (21.0%). (장래 근로 희망자의 일자리 선택 기준은 ‘일의 양과 시간대’(30.8%), 임금 수준(20.3%), 계속 근로가능성(16.3%) 차례로 높았다. 희망하는 임금 수준은 남성은 300만원 이상(34.9%)이 가장 높은데 견줘, 여성은 100~150만원 미만(21.0%)의 비중이 높았다.)

Meanwhile, the average age of those currently working at their longest-held job was 62.6 years, the same as last year. This is nearly 10 years higher than the average age (53) of those who left their longest-held job. The most common reasons for leaving their longest-held job were business downturn, suspension of operations, or closure (24.9%), poor health (22.1%), and caring for family members (15.2%). (한편 가장 오래 근무한 일자리에 근속 중인 사람의 평균연령은 62.6살로, 지난해와 같았다. 가장 오래 근무한 일자리를 그만둔 사람의 평균연령(53살)에 견주면 10살 가까이 높았다. 가장 오래 근무한 일자리를 그만둔 이유는 사업부진·조업중단·휴‧폐업(24.9%), 건강이 좋지 않아서(22.1%), 가족을 돌보기 위해(15.2%) 차례로 많았다.)

Park Su-ji, Reporter suji@hani.co.kr (박수지 기자 suji@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "National Pension Service Fueling KOSPI Overheating" Bloomberg Critique Met with... Financial Services Commission Silence (“국민연금, 코스피 과열 부추겨” 블룸버그 비판엔…금융위 침묵)
item.description:
The Financial Services Commission has rebutted a foreign media column arguing that the Korean stock market is becoming a "difficult market to invest in" like China. It emphasized that "Korea is an irreplaceable investment destination," citing the solid fundamentals of the Korean economy. However, it offered no specific explanation regarding the National Pension Service's adjustment of its domestic stock weighting, which the column flagged as one of the causes of the market's overheating. (한국 주식시장이 중국처럼 ‘투자하기 어려운 시장’이 되고 있다는 외신 칼럼에 대해 금융위원회가 반박했다. 한국 경제의 기초체력이 견고하다며 “한국은 대체 불가능한 투자처”라고 강조했다. 다만 칼럼이 증시 과열의 한 원인으로 지목한 국민연금의 국내주식 비중 조정에 대해서는 별다른 설명을 내놓지 않았다.)

The Financial Services Commission released a press explanatory note titled "The Government's Position on the Domestic Stock Market" at around 10 p.m. on the 4th. The note rebuts a column published by Bloomberg on the 3rd (local time) titled "South Korea Is Becoming Uninvestable, Too" (link). (금융위는 4일 밤 10시께 ‘국내증시에 대한 정부의 입장’이라는 제목의 보도설명자료를 냈다. 3일(현지시각) 블룸버그에 실린 ‘한국도 투자하기 어려운 시장이 되고 있다’(South Korea Is Becoming Uninvestable, Too)라는 제목의 칼럼을 반박하는 내용이다.)

Shuli Ren, a Bloomberg columnist covering Asian financial markets, wrote in the piece that the investment appeal of the Korean stock market is waning, citing the excessive volatility in the KOSPI recently. She attributed the cause to government intervention, describing it as the government's "clumsy attempt" to boost the KOSPI. The column criticized government market interventions—such as the introduction of single-stock leveraged products and the National Pension Service's upward adjustment of its domestic stock weighting—for fueling market overheating and volatility, which in turn caused investor losses. (아시아 금융시장을 담당하는 블룸버그 칼럼니스트 슐리 렌은 이 글에서 한국 증시의 투자 매력이 떨어지고 있다고 지적했다. 최근 코스피의 변동성이 지나치게 커졌다는 이유에서다. 정부의 개입을 그 원인으로 꼽았다. 칼럼은 “코스피 부양을 위한 정부의 어설픈 개입(clumsy attempt)”이라고 평했다. 단일종목 레버리지 상품 도입과 국민연금의 국내주식 비중 상향 조정 등 정부의 시장 개입이 증시 과열과 변동성을 키워 투자자 피해를 유발했다고 비판한 것이다.)

The column further noted: "In recent years, global asset managers have complained that China is unsuitable for investment, mainly due to two problems: failed government policies and indifference toward investors. Unfortunately, similar concerns are now being raised about South Korea." (이어 칼럼은 “최근 몇 년 동안 글로벌 자산운용사들은 중국이 투자하기에 부적합하다고 불평해왔다. 주된 이유는 정부의 정책 실패와 투자자에 대한 무관심이라는 두 가지 문제 때문이었다”며 “안타깝게도 한국에서도 비슷한 우려가 제기되고 있다”고 지적했다.)

The Financial Services Commission countered that the fundamentals of the domestic economy are more solid than ever. It explained that expected corporate earnings have also risen compared to the market peak. It assessed that the recent market volatility results from a combination of multiple factors and that signs of recovering investor sentiment are emerging. Regarding single-stock leveraged products, it said the effects of complementary measures are beginning to show. (금융위는 국내 경제의 기초체력이 어느 때보다 견고하다고 반박했다. 국내 기업의 예상 실적도 주가 고점 당시보다 높아졌다고 설명했다. 최근 증시 변동성은 여러 요인이 복합적으로 작용한 결과이며 투자 심리도 회복될 조짐이 나타나고 있다고 평가했다. 단일종목 레버리지 상품과 관련해서는 보완 대책의 효과가 나타나고 있다고 했다.)

The Financial Services Commission also took issue with the forced liquidation statistics cited in the column, arguing that they do not align with the facts and that their precise source cannot be verified. The column claimed that approximately 360,000 securities accounts had been forcibly liquidated, 62% of which belonged to investors under the age of 35. The FSC rebutted: "The average daily number of accounts subject to forced selling in June was around 3,000." Since the June market was open for 21 trading days, a simple sum would put the total number of forcibly liquidated accounts at roughly 63,000—a far cry from 360,000. (금융위는 칼럼에 인용된 강제청산 통계도 문제 삼았다. 사실관계와 맞지 않고 정확한 출처도 확인되지 않는다는 지적이다. 칼럼은 약 36만개의 증권계좌가 강제 청산됐고, 이 가운데 62%는 35살 미만 투자자의 계좌라고 제시했다. 금융위는 “반대매매 계좌는 6월 중 하루 평균 3천개 수준이었다”고 반박했다. 6월 증시는 21거래일 열려 이를 단순 합산하면 강제 청산된 계좌는 약 6만3천개로, 36만개와는 차이가 크다.)

The original source of the figures cited by the column has not yet been clearly confirmed. However, it can be verified that the numbers circulated through U.S. financial information platforms and similar channels. On the 30th of last month, the prediction market platform Polymarket mentioned the figure on X (formerly Twitter), and on the 1st of this month, the U.S. financial information platform Unusual Whales also reported the same numbers. Unusual Whales cited Citi Group as its source, but did not provide the title of the Citi report or the specific methodology used to derive the figures. (칼럼이 인용한 수치의 원자료는 아직 명확하게 확인되지 않았다. 다만 미국 금융정보 플랫폼 등을 중심으로 이 수치가 유통된 사실은 확인할 수 있다. 지난달 30일 예측시장 플랫폼 폴리마켓이 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 해당 수치를 언급했고, 이달 1일에는 미국 금융정보 플랫폼 언유주얼웨일스도 동일한 수치를 전했다. 언유주얼웨일스는 씨티그룹을 출처로 들었다. 하지만 씨티 보고서의 제목이나 구체적인 산출 방식은 제시하지 않았다.)

Meanwhile, the column also criticized the National Pension Service for raising its target weighting for domestic stocks this year, thereby avoiding the sale of its holdings. The column stated: "By not acting according to past guidelines, the National Pension Service helped drive the KOSPI into a frenzy." The Financial Services Commission did not issue a separate statement on the National Pension Service's adjustment of its domestic stock weighting. (한편 칼럼은 국민연금이 올해 국내주식 목표 비중을 높여 보유 주식 매도를 피한 조처도 비판했다. 칼럼은 “국민연금이 과거 지침에 따라 행동하지 않음으로써 코스피가 과열을 부추겼다(drive A into a frenzy)”고 지적했다. 금융위는 국민연금의 국내주식 비중 조정에 대해서는 별도의 입장을 밝히지 않았다.)

Reporter Ahn Tae-ho eco@hani.co.kr (안태호 기자 eco@hani.co.kr)
